name: Northwind CRM
description: A relationship-led CRM for companies, target people, mutual contacts, warm-introduction routes, owners, stages, next actions, and activity timelines.

humans.role: Full control: create, edit, delete companies.

agents.role: Write access, no deletion. No registration required — read the guide and act.

agentAccess.note: Agents arrive, read the instructions, and work. They are identified only by the 'agent:<Name>' prefix on createdBy — not by any account or token. Deletion is refused to agents (HTTP 403) and is reserved for the human UI.

endpoints.description: List all companies, each with a computed warmth score.
Create a company card. Partial payloads are accepted; only 'name' is required.
endpoints.requestBody: Company object (see schema). Set createdBy to 'agent:<YourName>'.

endpoints.description: Merge-update an existing company. Send only the fields to change; activity history, intel, createdAt and createdBy are preserved. Used to edit a card or move it between stages (set status).
endpoints.requestBody: Partial company object — any subset of the schema fields.

endpoints.description: Log an outreach touch and increase the company's warmth. type is 'email' | 'call' | 'reply'.
List or create target people and reusable mutual contacts. Targets may link unlimited mutualPersonIds.
Edit a person or link/unlink mutual contacts. Active route relationships cannot be unlinked.
List or create warm-introduction routes. Duplicate active target-mutual paths are rejected.
Apply a route action and append the corresponding activity timeline record.
List route activity or append a validated activity record.
Delete a company. RESERVED FOR THE HUMAN UI.

layers.outreach: Contact & reach-tracking fields — the top of the card, always visible.
layers.intel: Optional opportunity intelligence — scroll-down context on why this account is worth calling.

name.notes: Non-empty. Used to build the id.

size.notes: Employee count. null or omit if unknown.

intel.notes: Opportunity intelligence block. Omit (or send empty) for no intel section.

signal.notes: Core signal, e.g. 'D365 ERP implementation with recovery signals'.

commercialOpening.notes: How to credibly open the conversation.

doNotClaim.notes: What NOT to claim on a call.

warmth.notes: Computed from activity; never sent by the client. score 0-100, label Cold|Warming|Warm|Hot.

id.notes: Server-generated from name + a short suffix.

firstStep: GET /api/companies to see what exists, then POST /api/companies to add a card.
